description: Detailed information on Acquisition of Land, Building and Works, as per the Public Accounts of Canada is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Public Services and Procurement Canada | Services publics et Approvisionnement Canada. At the end of each fiscal year, government-wide financial information is published in the Public Accounts. This dataset, based on the Volume III of the Public Accounts, provides details for contracts of $250,000 or over ($25,000 or over for cost plus contracts) on acquisitions of land, building and works. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Public Services and Procurement Canada | Services publics et Approvisionnement Canada. Its tags are Receiver General, Government of Canada, Public Accounts, Volume III, Ministry. It offers 45 resource(s) in CSV, HTML, XML. The portal shows 2026-04-09 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
